title: Halting After a Deterministic Step
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine, with oracle, input bit string, and configuration guard $G$ fixed. Suppose the instruction at control state $l$ is the deterministic instruction $i$, and the halting condition holds for $N+1$ steps from the configuration at $l$. Then it holds for $N$ steps from the configuration obtained by applying one step of the machine in which every choice instruction is replaced by the fixed return value $ eta$.
hypotheses_covered: The instruction at $l$ is the deterministic instruction $i$
The fixed return value is $ eta$
The configuration at $l$ satisfies the halting condition for $N+1$ steps
